title: Will see after a month or two...
text: I guess curiosity is the motive. I'm not too sure but I'll see how this box goes after a month or two. I probably would suggest a mix of some fun and a mix of some useful. I would like to see the box go from something that might be considered junk to something, although older/recycled, could be useful or educational. I'm just curious what I might get. There was a nice tool. Maybe with enough feedback they can make this an interesting box.
label: neutral
